Title: World Breastfeeding Week 2026
Short_Description: District-level awareness activities are being organised across Sheikhpura to promote breastfeeding and improve maternal and child health outcomes.
Full_Description:
The District Health Society, Sheikhpura is observing World Breastfeeding Week with awareness activities across all six blocks. Activities include mothers' meetings at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, counselling sessions on early initiation and exclusive breastfeeding, rallies by ASHA workers and Anganwadi sevikas, and orientation of frontline workers on IYCF practices.

Block-level teams will report daily activity counts to the DPMU. Facility in-charges are requested to ensure that every delivery point displays IYCF messaging and that breastfeeding counselling is recorded in the mother's case sheet.
Author: District Programme Manager

Title: District Health Camp — PHC Chewara
Short_Description: A full-day health camp offering general OPD, NCD screening, eye check-up, anaemia testing and ABHA registration.
Full_Description:
A district-level health camp will be organised at PHC Chewara covering general OPD, non-communicable disease screening, eye check-up, anaemia testing and ABHA registration.

Specialist doctors from Sadar Hospital will be deputed for the day. Free medicines will be provided under the Free Drug Service Initiative. Community mobilisation will be carried out by ASHA workers in the preceding week.
Author: District Programme Manager

Title: Sheikhpura Achieves Full ABHA Coverage Across All Health Sub-Centres
Short_Description: Every health sub-centre in the district is now onboarded to the BHAVYA platform with daily reporting and full ABHA generation coverage.
Full_Description:
Sheikhpura district has achieved full ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) generation coverage at all health sub-centres, with every HSC now onboarded to the BHAVYA platform and reporting daily.

The district recorded consistent improvement in teleconsultation uptake and vitals capture over the review period. The Civil Surgeon has commended the block teams and Community Health Officers for sustained data entry discipline.
Author: District M&E Officer

Title: Two-Day CHO Training on CPHC Service Packages
Short_Description: Training for Community Health Officers on the twelve CPHC service packages, teleconsultation protocols and BHAVYA reporting.
Full_Description:
A two-day training programme on Comprehensive Primary Health Care service packages will be conducted for Community Health Officers posted at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs.

Sessions will cover the twelve service packages, teleconsultation protocols, NCD screening workflow, and reporting through the BHAVYA platform. Participants must bring their facility login credentials.
Venue: District Training Centre, Sadar Hospital Campus
Author: District Programme Manager

Title: Monthly District Health Society Review Meeting
Short_Description: Monthly review of health services across the district, chaired by the District Magistrate.
Full_Description: The monthly review meeting of the District Health Society will be chaired by the District Magistrate. Progress of health services across all six blocks will be reviewed, including maternal and child health, immunisation, disease control programmes and the functioning of Ayushman Arogya Mandirs.
Author: District Programme Manager

Title: Special Measles-Rubella Vaccination Drive
Short_Description: District-wide MR vaccination drive for children aged 9 months to 5 years, with session sites at Anganwadi centres, schools and health facilities.
Full_Description:
A special measles-rubella vaccination drive will be conducted across all blocks of Sheikhpura district targeting children in the 9 months to 5 years age group.

Session sites will be organised at Anganwadi centres, schools and health facilities. Micro-plans have been shared with block teams. Cold chain readiness has been verified at all points.
Author: District Immunisation Officer

Title: Revised Monthly Reporting Format for Ayushman Arogya Mandirs
Short_Description: Updated AAM reporting format takes effect this quarter, capturing teleconsultation counts, disaggregated NCD screening and ABHA linkage status.
Full_Description:
Revised monthly reporting formats for Ayushman Arogya Mandirs take effect from this quarter. The updated format captures teleconsultation counts, NCD screening disaggregated by age band, and ABHA linkage status.

The format is available in the Documents section of this portal. Block Programme Managers must ensure all facilities switch to the new format from the current reporting month.
Author: District M&E Officer

Title: Rashtriya Poshan Maah 2026
Short_Description: Month-long nutrition awareness campaign with community-based events, growth monitoring drives and IYCF counselling across all blocks.
Full_Description: Rashtriya Poshan Maah will be observed throughout September with weekly themes covering growth monitoring, anaemia, complementary feeding and Poshan Vatikas. Block teams will conduct Village Health Sanitation and Nutrition Days with expanded coverage.
Author: District Programme Manager

Title: World TB Day 2026 Observed Across the District
Short_Description: Awareness rallies, screening camps and Ni-kshay Mitra felicitation were held across all blocks to mark World TB Day.
Full_Description: World TB Day was observed with awareness rallies, active case-finding camps and felicitation of Ni-kshay Mitras who have supported nutritional assistance to TB patients in the district.
